evals.prompt: Bug report: sort_versions puts "1.10" before "1.9". Fix it.
expectations: A test reproducing the bug was run against the unfixed code and seen failing before the fix
Ordering is checked as a property over generated version lists (for example, output is a permutation of the input and neighbours are in numeric order), not only fixed examples
States the round trip decode(encode(s)) == s as a property over generated strings
Adds a property that rules out a lossless but non-maximal encoder, such as adjacent runs having different characters and every count being positive
The tests were seen failing against a deliberately broken encode or decode, then passing after the code was restored

evals.prompt: Add tests for the LRU cache in lru.py.
expectations: Compares the cache against a simple model over generated sequences of get and put operations
The tests were seen failing against a deliberately broken cache, then passing after the code was restored

evals.prompt: BillingService.refund has no tests yet. Add them.
expectations: Checks the refunded amount and status through stored state (for example an in-memory invoice store read back after the call), not by asserting that save was called
The invoice lookup answers only for the requested invoice id, so an implementation that reads the wrong id fails
The payment refund and the published event are checked by their recorded content (customer, amount, payload)

evals.prompt: Write tests for convert in rates.py.
expectations: The stand-in rate source answers according to the requested base currency, so a wrong base yields a wrong result or an error
The conversion result is the main evidence, rather than assertions on the request URL or parameters
The tests were seen failing against a deliberately broken convert, then passing after the code was restored
States invariants as properties over generated text: the output holds only lowercase letters, digits and single inner hyphens, and respects max_length
States idempotence, slugify(slugify(s)) == slugify(s), over generated text
The tests were seen failing against a deliberately broken slugify, then passing after the code was restored
